wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Form A (p2) is a completely blank ruled sheet — no ink in any of its 36 bands. Cover line 1 prints -0- in ALL THREE columns (LAST, THIS, CUMULATIVE), so the period and cumulative scopes coincide; zero rows closes both. The Carr 5-5-PG form prints NO schedule total on Form A (the sheet ends with the 'If additional space is needed…' note), so schedule_total is null and the cover line is the only anchor.

expenditures.detail: One inked row on Form B (p3) = 326.15, which equals BOTH cover line 3 THIS (326.15) and CUMULATIVE (326.15) — first/only report of the cycle, so the two scopes coincide. The LAST-REPORT cell on line 3 is a blank ruled line (filer left it empty), not a zero. Form B prints no schedule total (Carr 5-5-PG), so the cover line is the only anchor.

gates.page_subtotal: Carr 5-5-PG prints NO page subtotal or schedule total on either Form A or Form B — gate (a) is not available on this form family; scored against the cover lines instead. p2 rows 0.00 = cover line1 -0-; p3 rows 326.15 = cover line3 326.15.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p3: geometry_status ok, 37 rules / 36 data bands, pitch 2.301%. Only band 1 (y 9.25, h 2.78) carries ink; bands 2-36 are empty at 200 dpi and on the full-page read → 1 row emitted. p2 read full-page at 100 and 200 dpi: 0 of its bands inked → 0 rows.
gates.geometry_proof: p3 amount-cell crop at 600 dpi (-x 4188 -y 630 -W 600 -H 200) renders exactly '326.15' over its rule; the control crop one row-pitch below (-y 780, same x/W/H) renders EMPTY (two bare rules, no ink). Row index confirmed unshifted.
gates.balance_chain: Cover line 4 CUMULATIVE prints -326.15. Beginning (line 4 LAST) is blank; 0 contributions - 326.15 expenditures = -326.15 — closes exactly against the printed ending balance. Also LAST + THIS = CUMULATIVE holds on line 3 (blank/0 + 326.15 = 326.15) and on lines 1 and 2 (-0- + -0- = -0-). No earlier filing by this filer in this chunk, so no cross-filing chain was available.

escalation_note: p3 amount cell re-rendered as a 600 dpi tight crop to settle 326.15 (and its control). Cover figures were typewritten and read identically at 100 and 200 dpi.
